Quick pass from my side: thanks for pulling this together, Marissa. A few concrete points:

- Level mapping: L3 as "Senior IC" currently conflates two internal bands — recommend splitting into L3a (Individual Contributor Senior) and L3b (Senior + Early Staff) for clearer anchor placement. See comments in column 'k_comments'.
- APAC uplift: 7% looks light for SG/HK market for senior ICs. Suggest 10% for SG/HK L4+ and keep 7% for SEA Tier 2. I added a new column (geo_adj_proposal) in the sheet.
- Market comp: Radford's 'mid' value skews high for staff levels vs our closed offers — we should weight Radford 60% + field_survey 40% for final anchors.

I'll inline a short spreadsheet snippet in Drive; please review my k_comments before finalizing.

-Karthik

Hi Laura (and team) —

Thanks for the note and the extract. Quick answers:
- Radford 'mid' = median of our survey pool, not a mean.
- Figures in the _tech_levels_ report are total cash (base + target bonus) only; equity is reported separately.
- Our staff-level sample size is thinner in EMEA for certain subfunctions (we flag those in the appendix); recommend treating EMEA staff-level mids with a +/- 10% confidence band.

If helpful we can produce a weighted export (median by region + sample N) — happy to do that if you share which levels/markets you want prioritized.

Best,
Tanya Rivera
